name: smoke
description: Tiny cases that run on CPU in seconds. Not a performance signal -- a correctness gate. Every combination of causal and padding is here because that cross is where a naive SDPA swap breaks, and it breaks silently at padding_ratio 0.

cases.name: fp16
cases.note: fp16 has narrower dynamic range than bf16; the gate should cover both reduced-precision families.

cases.name: scaled
cases.note: input_scale moves which term of the OR criterion binds (see docs/precision-budget.md); without a case it is a claim, not a check.
